create_DummyLMConfig: create a DummyLMConfig dataclass to configure dictionary size, dataset size, and tokens per sample for benchmarking
build_DummyLMTask: build a DummyLMTask registered as dummy_lm that creates synthetic language model data for benchmarking fairseq models
run_DummyLMTask_load_dataset: run load_dataset on DummyLMTask to generate a DummyDataset with synthetic source tokens and targets for a given split
review_DummyLMTask_init: review the DummyLMTask constructor that builds a synthetic dictionary and creates dummy source and target sequences
test_DummyLMTask_dictionaries: test the source_dictionary and target_dictionary properties of DummyLMTask to verify they return the same synthetic dictionary
